items.label: Premium Faux Leather
items.value: This sectional sofa is crafted from high-quality PU faux leather that is soft and breathable. While less expensive than genuine leather, it offers a upscale appearance like genuine leather. This sectional leather sofa can not only meet your desire for light luxury and high-end furniture, but also meet your budget-friendly needs. It perfectly blends modern and mid-century styles, making it an ideal sofa for living rooms, bedroom, offices, and apartments

items.label: Spacious and Comfortable
items.value: This 100 inch leather sectional couch with 3 seat & ottoman is perfect for 3-4 people. The modular sofa features high-resilience foam seat cushions and backrests that offers superior comfort and lasting ergonomic support for your back ,waist, hip. The movable ottoman allows you to put your feet up and stretch out completely. The wide seating area and removable armrests pillows deliver a cozy and comfort experience for your rest and relaxation

items.label: Easy to Care
items.value: This mid-century modern couch features a durable, waterproof & pet-friendly faux leather fabric that can be easily wiped clean with a dry or damp cloth, keeping your sofa clean and comfortable with effortless. This faux leather sofa is easier to maintain than real leather and perfect for busy young people or the families with kids & pets. Leather side pockets provide the storage space for small items. Tips: There may be slight color difference due to light or display reasons

items.label: Sturdy and Durable
items.value: The frames (armrests, backrests, seat frames, support legs) of sectional leather couches are made of solid wood, offering durability and stability for long-lasting use. Sturdy wooden frame easily support up to 800lbs. The modern and minimalist design features clean lines and a sleek profile, effortlessly complementing a variety of home decors—from contemporary and industrial to mid-century modern. It's a stylish centerpiece for your living space

items.label: Easy to Assemble
items.value: This modular sectional sofa is quick and easy to assemble without the tools by following a few simple steps instructions. The leather sectional sofa ships in 2 boxes which may arrive separately. Please check all parts before full setup. Note: The cushions, backrest, and pillows are vacuum-packed. After unpacking, please pant it gently to fluff and allow 72 hours for fully expand. If you have any questions to our sofa, please feel free to contact us
